summary: The customer had a positive experience overall but was annoyed by the delay in service.
raw_text: I want to share my whole experience because I think it matters. I dropped the car off on Monday morning at about eight. The lady at the front desk was polite and wrote everything down carefully. They told me it would be ready by four in the afternoon, but in the end it was nearer half past five, which was a little annoying because I had to rearrange my evening. When I collected it the mechanic walked me round the car, showed me the old brake pads, and explained what else to keep an eye on over the next few months. The car now drives smoothly, the brakes feel firm and the strange vibration I had on the motorway is completely gone. The price was exactly what I was quoted. Overall I am very happy and I will be bringing my wife's car in next month.
